summary: Sufficiency-witness canon: preserve replay capsules and core-only re-entry trials whenever a reduced packet, support core, or public extract is being treated as enough; quarantine the stronger tiny-replay-capsule reading; and wire sufficiency witnesses into prompt/runbook/lint surfaces.

counterfactual_shadow.nearby_rejected_move: Promote the stronger claim that DelayBasin has already isolated genuine tiny replay capsules or sufficient continuation seeds rather than a narrower canon rule for replay-capsule hypotheses and core-only re-entry trials.
counterfactual_shadow.rejection_reason: Current evidence supports a canon rule for preserving candidate reduced packets, core-only replay surfaces, fixed or withheld context families, tolerated degradation bands, and reinflate or fallback consequences, but not yet the stronger claim that DelayBasin can isolate genuine tiny replay capsules in its own practice rather than simply becoming more honest about replay sufficiency.
